title: Motion spec - renderer-agnostic keyframes (compiled to CSS-animated SVG now, Lottie/GIF later)

source.description: figma = copied from Figma Motion keyframes; approximated = written from the brief, pending a Figma export; generated = preset applied by @library/forge

preset.description: forge motion preset name (generated motion only)

target.description: 'root' (whole asset) | path index in the regular icon SVG (number) | illustration part id (string)

property.description: rotate in degrees, translate in viewBox units, draw = 0..1 path trim

origin.description: transform origin in % of the target's box, default [50,50]
